column1: # Written currency aliases: original policy data; see docs/currency-resources.md.
# Lowercase keys; ASCII case and horizontal whitespace fold during recognition.
# Names require whitespace after the amount/scale. Values retain ISO identity
# and written source language. Bare dollar defaults to USD like the existing $.
# Ambiguous pound(s) needs explicit currency syntax or an adjacent monetary
# cue. Weight complements veto the weak cue; a qualified name is unambiguous.
# Prefix-only continuation hints keep whitespace cuts independent of chunks.
